column1: # Places where ubsite deliberately differs from ../index/data/srt.jsonl.
# The oracle is an independent parse and an excellent check, but it is not the
# authority: the SRT reference HTML in urantia-uversa-press-claude/misc/html is,
# because the press project's own text-verify run is gated against it.  Each row
# below was arbitrated against that HTML, and in every case the HTML agrees with
# us.  The gate requires EXACTLY this set -- a new disagreement fails the build,
# and so does one of these silently going away.

column5: build_srt.py appends unclaimed lines to the previous paragraph and ate \begin{multicols}{2}, detexing the {2}. HTML ends the paragraph at "existence."
\fbhyp{} is a forced line-break hyphen, not a compound hyphen; the word is unbroken in the canonical text. HTML: "UNREVEALED ORDERS."
The SRT uses ASCII "..." with no following space. HTML: "heard Jesus say, “...this sickness is really not to the death.”"
